claims.claim: On Friday, October 9, 2026, at 12:56 Panama time, an earthquake struck with its epicenter about 10 kilometers from Pitaloza Arriba in Herrera province.
claims.episode_span: at 12:56 Panama time, a quake struck about 10 kilometers from Pitaloza Arriba in Herrera province
claims.source_title: Terremoto no Panamá deixa cidades isoladas e moradores com medo de voltar para casa
claims.supporting_quote: O sismo foi registrado às 12h56, no horário local (17h56 GMT), com epicentro a 10 quilômetros de Pitaloza Arriba, na província de Herrera, na região central do país, segundo o Serviço Geológico dos Estados Unidos (USGS).

claims.claim: The US Geological Survey revised the Panama earthquake magnitude to 7.7 after an initial estimate of 8 and a second assessment of 7.6.
claims.episode_span: the US Geological Survey revised the magnitude to 7.7 after an initial estimate of 8 and a second assessment of 7.6
claims.source_title: Terremoto no Panamá deixa cidades isoladas e moradores com medo de voltar para casa
claims.supporting_quote: O USGS revisou a magnitude do terremoto para 7,7, após uma estimativa inicial de 8 e uma segunda avaliação de 7,6.

claims.claim: The epicenter was about 196 kilometers from Panama City.
claims.episode_span: about 196 kilometers from Panama City
claims.source_title: Vídeo mostra apresentadores 'fugindo' de estúdio durante transmissão ao vivo após terremoto no Panamá
claims.supporting_quote: O epicentro foi localizado a cerca de 196 quilômetros da Cidade do Panamá e a aproximadamente 14 quilômetros a sudoeste da comunidade de Pitaloza Arriba.

claims.claim: Panama's National Civil Protection System said 27 people were injured nationwide.
claims.episode_span: The National Civil Protection System said 27 people were injured nationwide
claims.source_title: Terremoto no Panamá deixa cidades isoladas e moradores com medo de voltar para casa
claims.supporting_quote: Segundo um comunicado do Sistema Nacional de Proteção Civil (Sinaproc), 27 pessoas ficaram feridas em todo o país em decorrência do sismo, que provocou danos em residências, centros educacionais, hospitais, igrejas, edifícios governamentais, portos e estradas.

claims.claim: René García, head of the Emergency Operations Center, told AFP there were no reports of deaths at that point.
claims.episode_span: René García, head of the Emergency Operations Center, told AFP that at that point there were no reports of deaths
claims.source_title: Terremoto no Panamá deixa cidades isoladas e moradores com medo de voltar para casa
claims.supporting_quote: O chefe do Centro de Operações de Emergência, René García, informou à AFP que, até aquele momento, não havia relatos de mortes.

claims.claim: President José Raúl Mulino said the disaster is large and that roads are totally destroyed.
claims.episode_span: President José Raúl Mulino, visiting an affected area, said the disaster is large and that roads are totally destroyed
claims.source_title: Terremoto no Panamá deixa cidades isoladas e moradores com medo de voltar para casa
claims.supporting_quote: — O desastre que enfrentamos é grande — afirmou o presidente José Raúl Mulino durante uma visita a uma das áreas afetadas. Há estradas “totalmente destruídas”, acrescentou.

claims.claim: Health Minister Fernando Boyd said Tonosí was cut off by land.
claims.episode_span: Health Minister Fernando Boyd said Tonosí, in Los Santos, was cut off by land
claims.source_title: Terremoto no Panamá deixa cidades isoladas e moradores com medo de voltar para casa
claims.supporting_quote: O ministro da Saúde, Fernando Boyd, informou que a localidade ficou isolada por terra.

claims.claim: Authorities recorded more than 100 aftershocks, some as strong as magnitude 6.
claims.episode_span: authorities recorded more than 100 aftershocks, some as strong as magnitude 6
claims.source_title: Terremoto no Panamá deixa cidades isoladas e moradores com medo de voltar para casa
claims.supporting_quote: Segundo as autoridades, foram registradas mais de 100 réplicas, algumas com magnitude de até 6.

claims.claim: Panama Canal authorities said the canal was operating normally and that it carries about 5 percent of international maritime trade.
claims.episode_span: the waterway, which carries about 5 percent of international maritime trade, was operating normally
claims.source_title: Terremoto no Panamá deixa cidades isoladas e moradores com medo de voltar para casa
claims.supporting_quote: As autoridades do Canal do Panamá anunciaram que a via, por onde passa cerca de 5% do comércio marítimo internacional, operava normalmente.

claims.claim: Tocumen airport closed temporarily and flights were diverted.
claims.episode_span: Tocumen airport closed temporarily and flights were diverted
claims.source_title: Terremoto no Panamá deixa cidades isoladas e moradores com medo de voltar para casa
claims.supporting_quote: O aeroporto de Tocumen, um importante centro de conexões aéreas da América Latina, fechou temporariamente, e vários voos foram desviados.

claims.claim: Tsunami alerts were issued for coastal areas of Costa Rica, Ecuador, Peru, Nicaragua, Guatemala, El Salvador, Chile and Mexico, and Hawaii was also flagged.
claims.episode_span: Tsunami alerts covered coastal areas of Costa Rica, Ecuador, Peru, Nicaragua, Guatemala, El Salvador, Chile and Mexico, with Hawaii also flagged
claims.source_title: Vídeo mostra apresentadores 'fugindo' de estúdio durante transmissão ao vivo após terremoto no Panamá
claims.supporting_quote: O terremoto levou à emissão de alertas para possíveis ondas perigosas em áreas costeiras da Costa Rica, do Equador, do Peru, da Nicarágua, da Guatemala, de El Salvador, do Chile e do México. O Havaí também chegou a ser apontado como uma região potencialmente em risco.

claims.claim: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said his department was mobilizing resources and personnel to assist.
claims.episode_span: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said his department was mobilizing resources and personnel
claims.source_title: Terremoto no Panamá deixa cidades isoladas e moradores com medo de voltar para casa
claims.supporting_quote: O secretário de Estado americano, Marco Rubio, informou na rede social X que seu departamento estava “mobilizando rapidamente recursos e pessoal para oferecer assistência”.

claims.claim: CAF donated 250,000 US dollars to Panama and made 50 million US dollars available through an emergency financing line.
claims.episode_span: CAF, donated 250,000 US dollars and made 50 million available on an emergency line
claims.source_title: Terremoto no Panamá deixa cidades isoladas e moradores com medo de voltar para casa
claims.supporting_quote: Por sua vez, o Banco de Desenvolvimento da América Latina (CAF) doou US$ 250 mil ao Panamá para “assistência humanitária imediata” e disponibilizou outros US$ 50 milhões por meio de uma linha de financiamento destinada a emergências.

claims.claim: Justice Luiz Fux ordered the Supreme Federal Court's technical area to give his office access to confidential inquiries reported by Alexandre de Moraes involving Jair Bolsonaro and allies, including the coup-attempt investigation and the fake-news inquiry.
claims.episode_span: Justice Luiz Fux ordered the Supreme Federal Court’s technical staff to release to his office access to confidential inquiries reported by Justice Alexandre de Moraes
claims.source_title: Fux quer analisar inquéritos de Moraes
claims.supporting_quote: O ministro Luiz Fux determinou que a área técnica do Supremo Tribunal Federal libere para seu gabinete o acesso a inquéritos sigilosos relatados por Alexandre de Moraes que envolvem o ex-presidente Jair Bolsonaro e aliados. Entre os casos, estão as investigações sobre a tentativa de golpe de Estado e o inquérito das fake news.

claims.claim: Columnist Malu Gaspar reported that a meeting this week between Moraes and Federal Police directors triggered Fux's order.
claims.episode_span: a meeting this week between Moraes and directors of the Federal Police was the trigger
claims.source_title: Fux quer analisar inquéritos de Moraes
claims.supporting_quote: Uma reunião entre Moraes e diretores da Polícia Federal nesta semana foi o estopim para a medida de Fux, conta a colunista Malu Gaspar

claims.claim: Recope estimated regular gasoline would rise by 89 colones to 808 per liter, super by 42 colones to 806, and diesel by 31 colones to 816, pending ARESEP approval.
claims.episode_span: Regular gasoline would rise by 89 colones, the largest move, to 808 a liter; super by 42 colones to 806; diesel by 31 colones to 816.
claims.source_title: A hit to the wallet: Fuel prices to rise by up to ¢89 in November
claims.supporting_quote: The Recope estimates that regular gasoline will see the largest increase—¢89—bringing the price to ¢808 per liter; Super gasoline is expected to rise by ¢42, reaching ¢806; Diesel is expected to increase by ¢31, which would set the price per liter at ¢816.

claims.claim: Recope estimated a 25-pound LPG cylinder would rise by 547 colones to 7,719.
claims.episode_span: A 25-pound cylinder of LPG, the size most used in home kitchens, would rise by 547 colones to 7,719.
claims.source_title: A hit to the wallet: Fuel prices to rise by up to ¢89 in November
claims.supporting_quote: For example, a 25-pound (11.34 kg) cylinder of LPG, the most commonly used in homes across the country for indoor and outdoor household kitchens, would reach ¢7,719, reflecting an increase of ¢547.

claims.claim: Chile declared Las Condes a disaster zone after flash floods and mudslides, with more than 1,000 residents evacuated.
claims.episode_span: Chile has declared the eastern Santiago district of Las Condes a disaster zone after flash floods and extreme mudslides, with more than 1,000 residents evacuated
claims.source_title: Chile declares Las Condes disaster zone after mudslide
claims.supporting_quote: Flash floods and extreme mudslides have turned Chile’s eastern Santiago district of Las Condes into a ‘disaster zone’, with over 1,000 residents evacuated from their homes.

claims.claim: Alpine said it lost all data and communication with Franco Colapinto's car during the Singapore sprint.
claims.episode_span: Franco Colapinto retired early from the Singapore sprint after Alpine said it had lost all data and communication with the car.
claims.source_title: Franco Colapinto abandonó rápido en la accidentada carrera sprint del GP de Singapur de Fórmula 1
claims.supporting_quote: Alpine informó que en el caso de Colapinto: “El equipo perdió todos los datos y la comunicación con el coche y necesitamos esperar a recuperarlo para entender lo que ha pasado”.
